name: Etruscan Necropolises of Cerveteri and Tarquinia
description: Just north of Rome, in Lazio, two vast Etruscan burial grounds lie near Cerveteri and Tarquinia. At Cerveteri's Banditaccia, thousands of tombs form a miniature city of streets and squares, with grassy mounds and rock-cut chambers shaped like houses. At Tarquinia, about 200 of the 6,000 rock-cut graves are painted with vivid scenes, some dating back to the 7th century BC.
